used_when: first turn; {identity} and {objective} come from the scenario

english_reference: Could you tell me about that, please?

used_when: the bot asked for something the caller knows; {fact} is a scenario fact

phrase: माफ करा, मला नीट समजलं नाही. जरा स्पष्ट सांगाल का?
english_reference: Sorry, I did not quite follow that. Could you explain it more clearly?
used_when: the bot's reply could not be used

phrase: माफ करा, पुन्हा एकदा सांगाल का?
english_reference: Sorry, could you say that again?
used_when: the bot's reply was empty or unclear

phrase: नाही, ते बरोबर नाही. योग्य माहिती {fact} आहे.
english_reference: No, that is not right. The correct detail is {fact}.
used_when: the bot stated a known fact wrongly

phrase: माफ करा, ते मला माहीत नाही.
english_reference: Sorry, I do not know that.
used_when: the bot asked for something the caller does not know

phrase: ठीक आहे, म्हणजे ते {fact} आहे, बरोबर?
english_reference: Right, so you are saying it is {fact} - is that correct?
used_when: reading back what the bot said

phrase: धन्यवाद, मला हवी असलेली माहिती मिळाली.
english_reference: Thank you, I have got what I needed.

phrase: ठीक आहे, धन्यवाद. मी नंतर पुन्हा प्रयत्न करेन.
english_reference: All right, thank you. I will try again later.
